description: This file provides an interface for interacting with the Soong build system used in Android development. It includes methods for executing build commands, querying variables, cleaning build outputs, and initiating builds.

classes.name: Soong
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods to interact with the Soong build system, including executing commands, cleaning output directories, and managing build targets.

methods.name: logging.Logger logger()
methods.description: Returns the module level logger for logging purposes.

methods.name: Soong.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Soong interface with the given build top directory and output directory.

methods.name: Soong.soong_ui
methods.description: Executes the soong_ui.bash script with provided arguments and environment, returning the output if requested.

methods.name: Soong.get_make_var
methods.description: Queries the build system for the value of a specified make variable.

methods.name: Soong.clean
methods.description: Removes the output directory if it exists, cleaning build artifacts.

methods.name: Soong.build
methods.description: Builds specified targets, ensuring the output directory exists and invoking the build process.
